Pictograms of Line B: Stony Point line

Station Pictogram Description
Baxter Sheep to represent the grazing nature of the suburb
Bittern After bittern birds
Crib Point Named after local “cribs” or “huts”
Frankston Local eagle sculpture
Hastings After Hastings, England. Representing the Battle of Hastings
Leawarra From aboriginal word meaning “Uprising”
Morradoo Meaning “Powder”
Somerville Suburb once famous for its horticultural shows
Stony point Boat facilities
Tyabb Aboriginal word meaning water hole or mud hole
